answer: A payout is split so that 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The ferrous schedule is applied in kernel and timber shows each instalment. Someone hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 861 identities would post 653 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
